title: ID0386477-DC/Si-D/FR -[a2JuDp] Charger Out of Order
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I am re-opening a ticket for a problem already mentioned in the
following ticket: ID0384636
I asked to keep this ticket open because the problem was
likely to come back, but it was closed.
The problem is the connector that changes from available to unavailable
status randomly (without there being a charging session or
action on the terminal). A reboot can sometimes resolve the problem, but it is not systematic. Conversely, the
connector does not necessarily go into fault after a charge.
I have already checked the main connectors in the terminal, and made
charging sessions when the connector had returned to
available, and everything was normal.
Root cause:
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  NO
Warranty Status: Active
